note: Transcribed receipts. The run files behind them (the cut, the stem, per-section JSON) are not published, so every run number is REPORTED and not quoted in posts. SOURCED entries name the public page read on 2026-11-19.

entries.label: REPORTED
entries.value: known cases 37/37: 28 proven sections HIGH, 6 proven sections MED (expected not FAIL), 3 known bad sections FAIL
entries.basis: validation run of the tool on one finished cut against a known-case list built from an earlier meter, eye checks and one cloud vision model's (Gemini, web app) worst-moments answer
entries.caveat: same cut the thresholds were tuned on; one song

entries.label: REPORTED

entries.label: REPORTED
entries.value: failed approaches and fixes (sections 5 and 7): hard singer gate gave offsets of 200-430 ms on proven sections, replaced by a smooth 80 ms mask used only when a second singer holds >= 20 % of the section; letter-timed vowel anchors carried about 200 ms of bias on rap and broke 4 known cases; at least 2 audio-measured anchors are needed before they vote
